tagline: The French Riviera of the East · Eco-Heritage Coastal Haven

railway_stations.name: Puducherry Railway Station (PDY)
railway_stations.notes: Southern Railway zone terminus connected to Chennai, Bengaluru, Delhi, Mumbai, and Kolkata.

bus_stands.name: Puducherry New Bus Stand (Maraimalai Adigal Salai)
bus_stands.notes: Operates 24/7 buses to Chennai (ECR & Tindivanam routes), Bengaluru, Tirupati, Coimbatore, and Madurai.

bus_stands.name: Puducherry Old Town Bus Stand (Bussy Street)
bus_stands.notes: Frequent local city buses to Auroville, JIPMER, Villianur, and Chunnambar.

places.name: Sri Aurobindo Ashram
places.review_summary: Peaceful spiritual sanctum enveloped in meditative silence around the flower-strewn Samadhi.

guidelines.dress_code: Modest clothing covering shoulders and knees. Footwear must be removed at entry.
guidelines.photography_rules: Photography strictly prohibited inside the Ashram premises.
guidelines.things_to_avoid: Talking loudly, mobile phone usage, carrying large baggage.
guidelines.accessibility: Ground floor courtyard and Samadhi area wheelchair accessible.

crowd_levels.source: Documented local footfall survey & ashram visitor registry estimates
crowd_levels.rush_hours: 09:30 AM - 11:00 AM & 04:30 PM - 05:45 PM on weekends

places.name: White Town (French Heritage Quarter)
places.image_credit: ExploreMate Pondicherry Heritage Feed / Authentic Reference Photo
places.review_summary: Pastel mustard yellow colonial villas, bougainvillea draped facades, and cobblestone lanes steeped in Franco-Tamil architecture.

guidelines.dress_code: Casual walking or cycling attire; breathable cotton.
guidelines.photography_rules: Exterior architectural photography permitted. Respect residential privacy.
guidelines.best_time_to_visit: 06:30 AM - 09:00 AM for soft morning light and zero vehicle traffic.
guidelines.things_to_avoid: Littering, honking, loud shouting in residential streets.
guidelines.accessibility: Paved flat roads and pedestrian sidewalks; wheelchair & stroller friendly.

crowd_levels.rush_hours: 05:00 PM - 07:30 PM (Evening walkers and café goers)

places.name: Promenade Beach (Rock Beach)
places.review_summary: 1.5 km sea-facing promenade along the Bay of Bengal, completely vehicle-free in the evenings for eco-friendly walking.

guidelines.dress_code: Casual comfortable beachwear and walking shoes.
guidelines.best_time_to_visit: 05:30 AM - 07:30 AM for sunrise or 17:30 - 20:30 for ocean breeze.
guidelines.things_to_avoid: Swimming into waves is strictly prohibited due to submerged boulders and dangerous undertows.
guidelines.accessibility: Wide level promenade suitable for wheelchairs and elderly walking.

crowd_levels.rush_hours: 06:00 PM - 08:30 PM on Saturdays and Sundays

places.name: Arulmigu Manakula Vinayagar Temple
places.review_summary: Ancient 500-year-old Ganesha temple renowned for golden chariot, intricate stone carved pillars, and rich Tamil Dravidian heritage.

guidelines.dress_code: Traditional Hindu temple dress: pants/dhotis for men, sarees/churidars for women. Shorts and sleeveless garments strictly forbidden.
guidelines.photography_rules: Photography strictly forbidden inside the sanctum sanctorum.
guidelines.things_to_avoid: Entering with footwear, leather accessories, or mobile cameras turned on.
guidelines.accessibility: Entrance ramp provided for wheelchair users.

crowd_levels.rush_hours: 07:30 AM - 09:30 AM & 06:30 PM - 08:30 PM (Aarti timings & Fridays)

places.name: Matrimandir Visitor Centre & Gardens
places.review_summary: Architectural wonder featuring the golden meditation sphere, sustainable permaculture exhibits, and shaded walking paths.

guidelines.dress_code: Modest, comfortable clothing and walking footwear.
guidelines.entry_fee: Free pass issued in-person at the Visitor Centre
guidelines.photography_rules: Exterior viewing point photography allowed. Inner meditation chamber requires advance booking and camera deposit.
guidelines.things_to_avoid: Visiting without in-person registration or during stormy monsoon winds.
guidelines.accessibility: Shaded walking pathways, battery electric golf carts available for senior citizens and disabled travelers.

crowd_levels.source: Auroville visitor centre pass count estimates

places.name: French War Memorial
places.review_summary: Solemn and poignant memorial dedicated to French soldiers from Puducherry who died during World War I.

guidelines.things_to_avoid: Climbing monument walls or stepping on solemn memorial floral arrangements.
guidelines.accessibility: Directly accessible from level Promenade pavement.

places.name: Pondicherry Museum & Gallery
places.review_summary: Fascinating collection of Arikamedu Roman excavation antiquities, Chola bronze relics, and French governor carriages.

guidelines.entry_fee: ₹10 for Adults, ₹5 for Children, ₹50 for Foreign Nationals (last verified 2026-03-01)
guidelines.photography_rules: Photography restricted in ancient Roman Arikamedu bead & coin sections.
guidelines.best_time_to_visit: 11:00 AM - 01:00 PM (Ideal indoor shelter during noon heat)
guidelines.things_to_avoid: Touching glass displays, carrying food inside galleries.
guidelines.accessibility: Ground floor displays wheelchair accessible; stairs to upper floor.

places.name: Serenity Beach & Surf Point
places.review_summary: Golden sands with gentle coastal breakers, traditional wooden catamarans, and eco-certified beginner surf schools.

guidelines.best_time_to_visit: 06:30 AM - 09:30 AM for surf lessons with calm waves.
guidelines.things_to_avoid: Swimming alone past the boulder groin without certified instructors.
guidelines.accessibility: Direct motorable road to beach promenade; soft sand terrain.

places.name: Eden Beach (Blue Flag Certified)
places.review_summary: Eco-label Blue Flag certified beach with zero plastic waste zones, solar lighting, and clean bathing waters.

guidelines.photography_rules: Allowed. Commercial drone filming requires prior coastal zone permit.
guidelines.things_to_avoid: Single-use plastics, alcohol, smoking, and glass bottles strictly banned.
guidelines.accessibility: Blue Flag certified wheelchair ramp leading to the water edge with specialized amphibious beach wheelchairs.

crowd_levels.source: Blue flag beach management board records

places.name: Casablanca Heritage Department Store
places.review_summary: Iconic multi-level shopping venue in Mission Street featuring handwoven linen, organic leather goods, artisanal home decor, and mini café.

guidelines.photography_rules: Exterior photo allowed; kindly ask permission for clothing displays.
guidelines.things_to_avoid: Carrying open food inside boutique floors.
guidelines.accessibility: Elevator accessible to all three floors.

places.name: Cluny Embroidery Centre
places.review_summary: 18th-century French convent workshop supporting underprivileged local craftswomen.

places.name: Paradise Beach
places.review_summary: Sandy, scenic and relaxed beach reached by ferry boat ride from Chunnambar Boat House.

places.name: Pondy Marina Beach
places.review_summary: Developed waterfront beach with wide sands, evening food stalls, and proximity to the New Lighthouse.

places.name: Auroville Beach
places.review_summary: Quiet coastal stretch for peaceful walks, sunrise views, and gentle sea breezes north of town.

places.name: Mahatma Gandhi Statue
places.review_summary: Four-metre bronze statue framed by eight ornate monolithic granite pillars from Gingee Fort.

places.name: Aayi Mandapam (Bharathi Park)
places.review_summary: White Greco-Roman pavilion in Bharathi Park honoring a generous local woman of 16th-century legend.

places.name: Old Lighthouse
places.review_summary: 19th-century French colonial maritime tower overlooking Goubert Avenue and the Bay of Bengal.

places.name: Raj Niwas (Governor's Palace)
places.review_summary: Stately 18th-century French neoclassical palace, official residence of the Lieutenant Governor.

places.name: Arulmigu Manakula Vinayagar Temple
places.review_summary: Ancient Ganesha temple predating French colonial arrival with ornate golden chariot.

places.name: Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus
places.review_summary: Magnificent Gothic Revival basilica featuring 28 rare stained-glass biblical portraits.

places.name: Église de Notre Dame des Anges
places.review_summary: Pastel pink and cream Greco-Roman church with limestone-egg mortar facing the sea.

places.name: Cathedral of Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception
places.review_summary: Historic 300-year-old mother church of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Pondicherry.

places.name: Vedapureeswarar Temple
places.review_summary: Historic Shiva temple in Heritage Town with 75-foot Raja Gopuram.

places.name: Thirukameswarar Temple, Villianur
places.review_summary: Ancient 12th-century Chola Shiva temple located in Villianur with sacred spring-fed tank.

places.name: Kanniga Parameswari Temple
places.review_summary: Unique temple combining French architraves and ionic pillars with Dravidian sanctum art.

places.name: Meeran Mosque
places.review_summary: Historic 350-year-old Gothic-Islamic mosque in Heritage Town.

places.name: Kuthba Mosque
places.review_summary: One of the oldest documented mosques in central Puducherry.

places.name: Jamia Mosque
places.review_summary: Prominent central mosque in the Muslim quarter with open prayer courtyard.

places.name: Bharathi Park (Government Park)
places.review_summary: Tranquil central green space surrounded by Raj Niwas and the High Court.

places.name: Botanical Garden
places.review_summary: 22-acre historic French colonial garden founded in 1826 with over 1,500 botanical species.

places.name: Jawahar Toy Museum
places.review_summary: Quaint museum near the Old Lighthouse exhibiting traditional dolls and toys from Indian states.

places.name: Chunnambar Boat House
places.review_summary: Popular backwater recreational center and ferry boarding point for Paradise Beach.

places.name: Ousteri Wetland and National Park
places.review_summary: Century-old freshwater wetland and designated bird sanctuary hosting migratory avifauna.

places.name: Arikamedu Archaeological Site
places.review_summary: Ancient Indo-Roman maritime port and archaeological site on the Ariyankuppam River.

places.name: Auroville Visitors Centre
places.review_summary: Information hub for Auroville with photo galleries, video screenings, eco-boutiques, and cafes.

places.name: Jawaharlal Nehru Statue
places.review_summary: Seafront statue of India's first Prime Minister facing the Gandhi memorial on Goubert Avenue.

places.name: Dupleix Statue
places.review_summary: Historical bronze statue of French Governor Joseph François Dupleix at the southern promenade.

places.name: Romain Rolland Library
places.review_summary: One of the oldest functioning public libraries in India, established in 1827.

places.name: French Institute of Pondicherry (IFP)
places.review_summary: Premier Indology and scientific research institute founded in 1955 on Saint Louis Street.

places.name: Alliance Française de Pondichéry
places.review_summary: Vibrant French cultural centre on Rue Suffren with art gallery, cinema, and cafe.

places.name: Hotel de Ville / Municipal Office
places.review_summary: Historic 19th-century French civic town hall rebuilt along Goubert Avenue.

places.name: Old Port / Old Harbour Area
places.review_summary: Historic 284-metre iron shipping pier remnants from 1862.

places.name: Auroville Farms & Green Belt
places.review_summary: Lush reforestation belt with organic spirulina, dairy, and regenerative permaculture farms.

places.name: Karaikal Beach
places.review_summary: Wide sandy beach in the Karaikal enclave, roughly 130 km south of central Puducherry.

accommodations.name: Villa Shanti Heritage Hotel
accommodations.eco_badge: Solar Hot Water & Zero Single-Use Plastics
accommodations.description: Restored 19th-century French colonial mansion with traditional inner courtyard, sustainable passive cooling architecture, and organic dining.

accommodations.name: Maison Perumal - CGH Earth
accommodations.address: 44 Perumal Koil St, Heritage Town, Puducherry 605001
accommodations.description: Award-winning Chettinad-style restored residence honoring authentic Tamil crafts, terracotta tiles, and local community sourcing.

accommodations.name: Promenade Seafront Boutique Hotel
accommodations.description: Overlooking the Bay of Bengal, offering panoramic ocean vistas and zero-emission walking access to all White Town sights.

accommodations.name: Auroville Green Guesthouse
accommodations.description: Serene and budget-conscious forest retreat built with compressed earth blocks, solar power, and community kitchen.

accommodations.name: Village & Beach Resort
accommodations.description: 35-acre organic farmland sanctuary featuring recycled heritage houses, Ayurvedic wellness, and farm-to-table dining.

restaurants.name: Coromandel Café & Artisanal Kitchen
restaurants.address: 8 Romain Rolland St, White Town, Puducherry 605001
restaurants.description: Exquisite European & French cuisine served in an art-filled 19th-century French mansion with an organic produce focus.
restaurants.eco_practice: Direct farm-sourced heirloom vegetables and zero plastic packaging.

restaurants.name: Café des Arts
restaurants.description: Bohemian colonial café with vintage posters and hibiscus gardens serving wholesome French crêpes, baguettes, and organic coffees.
restaurants.eco_practice: Fair-trade shade-grown coffee and upcycled colonial furniture.

restaurants.name: Surguru Spot
restaurants.description: Legendary South Indian vegetarian dining offering authentic crispy ghee roast dosas, idlis, and traditional filter kaapi.
restaurants.eco_practice: Traditional banana leaf dining and 100% plant-based local ingredients.

restaurants.name: Tanto Pizzeria (Auroville)
restaurants.address: Kuilapalayam, Main Road, Auroville, Tamil Nadu 605101
restaurants.description: Wood-fired artisanal pizzas baked using stone ovens, handmade mozzarella, and fresh organic herbs picked straight from Auroville farms.
restaurants.eco_practice: Solar-supplemented ovens and 100% compostable bio-waste stream.
